root_cause: Concurrent Prime-RL pytest validation activated tests/conftest.py::cleanup_zombies, which runs pkill -f torchrun and pkill -f VLLM. It sent SIGTERM to the live trainer and killed the inference workers. The later ACP empty-reply warnings occurred during launcher teardown and did not cause the termination.
decision: Archive the partial output as operator-invalid and rerun the identical committed Run 265 config without concurrent Prime-RL tests. Do not count these traces toward training or selection.
